dct_title_s: Viet Nam - Tropical storm on Jul 01 2026
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[1001281\_13](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_ts_events/items?event_id=1001281) Tropical storm during the period Jul 01 2026-Jul 04 2026 in Viet Nam, China, Laos. The center of the storm was located near latitude 21.6 longitude 107.9. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
